subject: Mathematics
title: Word Problem Warrior
tagline: Translate real-world problems into equations and solve them!

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.question: Naledi has R20 and spends R7 at the grocery store. How much money is left?
stages.wrongFeedback: Not quite — the answer is R13.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.question: Aisha has R171 and spends R58 at the spaza shop. How much money is left?
stages.wrongFeedback: Not quite — the answer is R113.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.question: Kagiso buys 3 pencils at the market stall, each costing R167. How much does Kagiso spend in total?
stages.wrongFeedback: Not quite — the answer is R501.

stages.name: Stage 4
stages.question: Nomvula shares 928 notebooks equally into 2 bags. How many notebooks go in each bag?
